template.name: Cards That Copy or Clone Creatures

easyPrerequisites: You have three or more opponents.
notablePrerequisites: Opponents cannot block creatures you control.
description:
If needed, create at least one copy of Professional Face-Breaker, or cast the Clone as a copy of it.
Deal combat damage to at least three opponents, triggering Professional Face-Breaker and the copy of Professional Face-Breaker
Resolve all Professional Face-Breaker triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to untap all attacking creatures you control, give them lifelink, trample and haste, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.
notes: The combo fails to produce enough mana once you have two or fewer opponents if only one copy of Professional Face-Breaker exists. If you generate more copies, you can get more iterations.

description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Professional Face-Breaker by sacrificing a Treasure, exiling the top card of your library and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

feature.name: Infinite untap of creatures you control
Infinite mana creatures you control can produce

easyPrerequisites: You have three or more opponents.
notablePrerequisites: Opponents cannot block creatures you control.
description:
Declare Mardu Siegebreaker as an attacker, triggering its second ability, creating a token copy of Professional Face-Breaker that is tapped and attacking each opponent.
Deal combat damage with Mardu Siegebreaker and any number of Professional Face-Breaker token(s), triggering each Professional Face-Breaker, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate up to five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R} for each Treasure sacrificed this way.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
notes: The combo assumes that each opponent and each Professional Face-Breaker will survive the first combat phase. The pre-requisites may vary if this is not the case. You may also perform this combo with less opponents but will require more mana. Once you have five Professional Face-Breaker tokens, this combo will break even.

feature.name: Exile your library with the ability to play the exiled cards until end of turn

description:
Activate Professional Face-Breaker by sacrificing a Treasure, which is also a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Professional Face-Breaker ability, exiling the top card of your library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control without summoning sickness

feature.name: Infinite untap of creatures you control
Infinite mana creatures you control can produce

easyPrerequisites: You control an additional creature that does not have summoning sickness, or you control a Treasure.
notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Vihaan triggers, causing Treasures you control to become 3/3 Construct Assassin creatures in addition to their other types.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Professional Face-Breaker's first ability.
Resolve the Professional Face-Breaker trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature with Breath of Fury attached, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature, untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
notes: You should attach Breath of Fury to a Treasure when possible. On the first iteration, if you didn't control a Treasure upon starting the combo, you can attach Breath of Fury to another creature without summoning sickness. For every other iteration, attach Breath of Fury to the Treasure made previously.

description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Atsushi, adding {C}{C}.
Atsushi dies, triggering itself and Mortuary.
Resolve the Atsushi trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, causing you to put Atsushi on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Professional Face-Breaker by sacrificing a Treasure, exiling Atsushi from the top of your library and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Activate the two remaining Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Atsushi from exile by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

feature.name: Cast all spells in your library

manaNeeded: {4}{R}{W}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Mondrak by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Mondrak enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create two token copies of Mondrak with haste.
Cast Pia Nalaar either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {R}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Pia Nalaar enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create eight token copies of Pia Nalaar with haste.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three creatures, creating eight Treasure tokens.
Activate Professional Face-Breaker by sacrificing a Treasure, causing you to exile the top card of your library with the ability to cast it this turn.
Repeat steps 5 and 6 as required until you exile a nonland card and have enough Treasures to cast it.
Activate any number of Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding enough mana to cast the nonland card.
Cast the nonland card from exile by paying its mana cost.
Each Pia Nalaar triggers, creating a total of 72 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens with haste.
You may optionally repeat from step 5 as desired/able, or you may use Prosperous Partnership to tap the Thopter tokens and make up to 184 Treasure tokens.
